name: BatLife
description: Battery level, health, cycles, power and time left, from your Mac's battery.
author: Giuseppe
details: Everything your battery knows, one click away. The button is the charge level, colored by how full it is (blue while charging); open it for the health of the battery, the charge cycles, the power in use, the time left and the temperature.
features: Charge level as the button, green to red
Power in use and time to empty or full
A small graph of the last minutes
permissions: Reads the battery from macOS. No permission needed.
